message: No detected input validation: The code only replaces NaNs with zeros via np.nan_to_num and reshapes data, but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded directly from local pickle files with no checksum verification, signature validation, or any authentication of the data source.

No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, validation against expected label sets, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the data preparation path.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The only data-quality step is NaN replacement via np.nan_to_num in normalize_data; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly check, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code constructs the MTAD_GAT model from scratch and does not load any pretrained weights or serialized model files, so no integrity verification (hash check, signature, pinned revision) is performed or needed in this path.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads data and creates datasets/loaders but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous-sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, gradient anomaly analysis, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop or surrounding code.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer is a standard torch.optim.Adam with no DP-SGD wrapping, Opacus integration, or any other differential privacy mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries or robustness stress tests (e.g., FGSM, PGD, Foolbox, ART) are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train and test datasets are split, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no independent holdout isolation enforced programmatically, and only a single set of loss metrics is reported without cross-validation or independent metric sources.
No detected input sanitization: The code converts raw data directly to tensors and passes it through the pipeline without any shape, range, or schema validation on inference inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or anomaly score sanity before they are returned or used downstream.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a time-series anomaly detection model (MTAD-GAT), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
